intro.title: useSyncExternalStore
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React component that displays a real-time counter, updated from an external store. You will learn how to use the useSyncExternalStore hook to subscribe to changes in external data sources and keep your UI in sync. The main technologies involved are React hooks, JavaScript functions, and a basic external store object. This beginner-friendly lesson will help you understand how to integrate external state into your React applications efficiently.
intro.usecase: useSyncExternalStore is essential for connecting React components to external state sources like browser APIs, third-party libraries, or custom stores. You'll use it in dashboard applications that need to sync with real-time data streams, such as live financial charts or collaborative editing tools. It's also crucial for implementing responsive UI components that react to browser events like network status changes or viewport resizing. This hook allows you to create seamless integrations with non-React systems while maintaining React's declarative programming model.
